body: @mjbvz and @jrieken is it ok to all allow through `class` on spans?

Actually, we were letting class on spans through already with this
https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/464f3de63c439ecbeffde58b0a36326f995528f5/src/vs/base/browser/markdownRenderer.ts#L233
Fix is to let class through.
Per discussion, we allow through class, but only with the codicon class.

The fix in action (I added a $(plus) into the hover before the label):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38270282/84390055-50daa680-abf7-11ea-8176-8a6037c4819b.png)

issue.title: Fix hover codicons not working on VS Code v1.46.0
